subject: EOQ stabilization: commit heatmap and ledger-ready queue
body:
From: Dana Clark <dana@nimhealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Reed <marcus.reed@nimhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Q3 Close: PO timing & final acceptance criteria

Hi Olga,

Quick one as we lock Q3 on our side — attached is PO-007 for the Redwood subscription addendum. Two asks:

1) Can you confirm the earliest ledger posting date once we sign? We need a firm invoice date for our internal close.
2) We have three feature-flagged accounts that need the dedicated capacity by 7/20; confirm whether the commit window on your side aligns with that.

I've attached the PO and a short checklist. Please let me know who on your finance ops team I should loop for final invoice delivery.

Thanks,
Dana Clark
CFO, Nimbus Health
Attachment: NIMBUS_Q3_PO-007.pdf

----
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Dana Clark <dana@nimhealth.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: PO timing & final acceptance criteria

Dana — thanks for sending this over. Quick summary and next steps from our side:

- Ledger posting: we can issue a final invoice the business day after countersignature. If PO is countersigned today, estimate invoice date = 2027-07-13, with ledger posting to follow EOD 07/13 in our AR system. (Finance ops will confirm once we route the doc.)
- Commit window: we can sequence the dedicated capacity changes in the following order: 
  * Priority A: three feature-flagged accounts (provisioning target 7/20)
  * Priority B: remaining tenancy adjustments (7/21–7/22)
- Required approvals: need sign-off from Nimbus on the acceptance criteria in section 2 of the PO (performance SLOs) to move into queue.

I've attached our commit runbook (redwood_commit_runbook_v2.xlsx) — it lists checkpoints: code freeze, infra pre-provision, canonical test run, and final handover. Please review the heatmap on tab "Queue" and tell us any hard blockers.

Finance ops owner: David Kim (cc) will take the invoice routing and confirm GL code. Laura will coordinate provisioning windows with infra.

Action items:
- Dana: confirm acceptance criteria by 7/13 3pm PT (or flag items)
- David: confirm invoice GL and post date
- Laura: lock provisioning slots and send calendar invites

Olga Petrov
Manager, Enterprise Sales Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_commit_runbook_v2.xlsx

----
From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Dana Clark <dana@nimhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: PO timing & final acceptance criteria

Thanks — I confirm GL code 5102 (Recurring Revenue) and payment terms net 30 per the SOW. If we receive countersignature today we will generate invoice 2027-07-13 and route for posting; I will update once the AP ticket is created.

Also: to avoid any reconciliation delays please ensure the PO reference (PO-007) is on the remittance.

-David
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

----
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dana Clark <dana@nimhealth.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q3 Close: PO timing & final acceptance criteria

Looping back with the provisioning plan — calendar invites for the 7/20 provisioning window have been sent to Nimbus engineering (Marcus) and our infra runbook owner. Short checklist for handover:

- 7/18 10am PT: final canary test (internal)
- 7/19 4pm PT: smoke test with Nimbus staging account
- 7/20 9am PT: production cutover (30-minute maintenance window)

If Dana can confirm acceptance criteria by EOD 7/13 we will lock everything. If there are any constraints on the maintenance window please reply and we will adjust.

Thanks everyone — good to be aligned.

Laura Bennett
Senior Program Manager, Platform Delivery
Redwood Inference
